openBlockers: TIMELOCK DELAY IS ZERO. The reserve pool's owner is a TimelockController with minDelay 0, so it is not a timelock: a leaked deployer key can redirect the pool's entire reserve to a malicious yield source in one transaction, with no window for anyone to react. Deployed this way deliberately on the operator's instruction. Raising it is cheap and can be done now; lowering it always costs the current delay. Do this before real float arrives.
Regulatory counsel on the buyback shape has not been obtained. ASSET_MARKETS.md section 10 flags 'float interest funds a buyback of a token' as closer to the line than a plain 1:1 peg.
Morpho USDG/USDe utilization was 90.3% at deploy. SharedReservePool._recallIfNeeded pulls from Morpho on demand and reverts at 100% utilization. The pool has no idle-buffer policy.
